description: This file implements the Thread class for managing thread creation, control, and synchronization in a cross-platform manner (Windows and POSIX). It includes thread lifecycle management, priority settings, and thread naming, with references to external synchronization and utility functions.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A class that encapsulates thread creation, management, and synchronization for cross-platform threading.

methods.name: Thread::Thread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes thread attributes and creates the thread based on platform.

methods.name: Thread::~Thread
methods.description: Destructor that terminates the thread.

methods.name: Thread::Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread (Linux-specific).

methods.name: Thread::ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ID.

methods.name: Thread::StartThread
methods.description: Static method that serves as the thread entry point, managing thread lifecycle.

methods.name: Thread::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the thread; can be overridden for custom setup.

methods.name: Thread::Terminate
methods.description: Stops the thread and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: Thread::Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread (platform-specific).

methods.name: Thread::Init
methods.description: Sets the thread state to initialized.

methods.name: Thread::Stop
methods.description: Sets the thread state to stopping.

methods.name: Thread::Block
methods.description: Sets the thread state to deactivated.

methods.name: Thread::Run
methods.description: Sets the thread state to running.

methods.name: Thread::PriorityMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::PriorityMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::Priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority.

methods.name: Thread::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: Thread::State
methods.description: Returns the current thread state.

methods.name: Thread::State
methods.description: Sets the thread to a new state if valid.

methods.name: Thread::ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread name (Windows-specific debug).

methods.name: Thread::GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack for debugging (debug build).
